title: Roulette
body:
Syntax: roulette number <0-36> <wager>  |  roulette <red|black|odd|even|low|high> <wager>

Description: Plays roulette with a gambler NPC. Wagered in MISSION POINTS, not ryo. A straight number pays 36x; the other bet types pay 2x.

Each village has its own dedicated Roulette Room, connected off the Gambling Den.

Date: 2026-08-27
